0c05d5502c44.title: Missing Error Handling
0c05d5502c44.reason: An absent kind, title or prompt reads as "" and is then refused: kind must be chat or task, the title 1 to 120 characters and the prompt 1 to 8,000 after trimming (job() returns Err, the model gets "Refused, nothing made"). spawn_tests.rs checks the empty cases.

5181c61e2eb2.fixed: web/src/api/mock.ts: start_work with kind task adds a task to the chat's project (or fails outside a project) like the server; spawn.spec covers it
5181c61e2eb2.title: Incomplete Mock Implementation
5181c61e2eb2.reason: The demo only showed new chats. It now makes tasks too, with the same result text and Open the task button.

5a70e44e1376.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
5a70e44e1376.reason: The column name comes from the Scope enum as one of two literals (project_id, chat_id); nothing a user or model sends reaches it, and every value is bound with ?.

716df022850a.title: Potential Resource Leak / Unbounded Growth
716df022850a.reason: Facts are the user's own notes, shown in the Facts tab where they edit and delete them, and removed with their chat or project. Pruning ones the prompt left out would delete data the user can still see and recall; the prompt itself stays within its 3,000-character budget.

7cd880bfb70d.title: Missing Input Validation
7cd880bfb70d.reason: resend reads the message with WHERE id = ? AND chat_id = ? after chat_editor confirmed the caller may write in that chat, so a message of another chat is NotFound; api_resend_tests.rs checks an unknown id and another user.
